headline: Ukraine says it sank Russian corvette in Libya
pages: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Monday that Ukraine sank a Russian navy corvette moored at a port in Libya. He said seven maritime drones hit the ship, the Merkury, in a surprise attack on Sunday. Zelenskyy said it was one of Russia's newest vessels, commissioned a year after the 2022 full-scale invasion. The Kremlin declined to comment. The strike took place about 2,400 kilometers from the front line. Fighting at home continued. Regional police said a Russian strike on an apartment block near Kyiv killed 11 people, and three people died in a strike on a hospital in Zaporizhzhia. Separately, the European Commission proposed a new round of sanctions targeting Russian banks.
The strike shows Ukraine can hit Russian assets far beyond its borders. Source: NPR.
